heading: 🛰️ Faction Profile: United Nations of Mega Corparations (UNMC)
🏢 Overview
blocks.text: The so-called "United Nations" is now a sleek, corporate puppet—a patchwork of branding, politics, and profit margins. Behind the scenes, a coalition of megacorps pulls the strings through the Board of Stakeholders. Warfare is not a tragedy—it’s a performance. UNDF units are sleek, transformable, and saturated with high-tech tools designed to maximize “operational synergy.”

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Corporatocracy: Public institutions are marketing fronts.

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Decentralized Command: Each mech is backed by a different corporate sponsor.

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Marketing Warfare: Mechs are as much propaganda as they are weapons.

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Aerospace Dominance: Mechs transform into high-speed jets or strikers.

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Synergistic Targeting: Units gain bonuses when coordinating with others.

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Objective-Driven Efficiency: Bonuses while securing assets or delivering “PR wins.”

heading: 🏢 Overview
blocks.text: Fragile but Flashy: Tech-heavy but not built for grindfests.

heading: 🤖UNDF Aegis-Line Frame - 27pts
blocks.text:
“Stability is profit. Projection is peace.”
 The Aegis-Line Frame is the dependable core of most UNDF deployments. Built to hold ground and engage in flexible combat, it blends melee deterrence, ranged harassment, and survivability. It doesn’t shine in any one area — but it always shows up.

paragraphs: Reliable all-rounder for holding ground, trading hits, and supporting objective play. Excels in synergy with snipers, recon, or elite flight units.

heading: 🛰️ UNDF Interceptor (Exclusive) 62 pts
blocks.text: Flight Mode: High-speed suppression with missile alpha strike. Great for flanking or softening entrenched targets. Cannot hold objectives — it’s a strike pass.

heading: 🛰️ UNDF Interceptor (Exclusive) 62 pts
blocks.text: Mobile Weapons Mode: Keeps the high speed, loses the defence penalty. Acts like a fast gunship — excellent for repositioning and supporting fire.

heading: 🛰️ UNDF Interceptor (Exclusive) 62 pts
blocks.text: Mech Mode: Slower but tough. Best for holding ground, anchoring lines, or switching to tanky play when missiles are spent.

heading: 💥 UNDF Hammernet-Frame 66pts
blocks.text:
“They may fly, but we define the sky.”
 A heavy fire-support mech built to deliver overwhelming suppressive fire and clear LZs for transforming interceptors. Its quad-linked Great Cannons dominate ground lanes, while triple missile pods provide flexible anti-air and saturation fire.

heading: 🕷️ UNDF Surveyor-5 “Crawler” 26 pts
blocks.text:
“If you saw it, it already tagged you.”
 The Surveyor-Class Crawler is a compact quadrupedal recon mech used for forward spotting, mobile harassment, and targeting uplinks. Built by Stratos Inc. and deployed in advance of most air operations, it is designed for speed, data collection, and coordinated fire support.
